Doppel native Android line icons

Source: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide
Pinned upstream revision: 2bfb9bb1bae5d74f6a9f81640ddd8bccc2c71860
Retrieved: 2026-09-07
License: ISC, with the upstream Feather-derived MIT notices preserved
in Lucide-LICENSE.txt. No additional icon runtime library is required.

Original SVG paths are preserved. SVG circles, lines, polylines and rounded
rectangles are converted structurally to equivalent Android pathData.
The 24-unit viewBox, 2-unit stroke, rounded caps/joins and transparent fill
are preserved. currentColor becomes a neutral default, tinted by the UI.
No SVG transforms, external resources, gradients or unsupported primitives
were accepted. VectorDrawable uses only attributes available by API 26.

The launcher foreground reuses layers-2 paths in a centered 108-unit
adaptive icon (scale 2.2, translation 27.6) with white strokes. Its solid
graphite background and Android adaptive mask are local presentation.
